mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 62 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Community Park, and we have a moderate air quality index of 56 today.

The city reminds residents that Pellitteri Waste Systems handles local refuse and recycling collection, and winter parking rules kick in on November 20, requiring alternate-side parking to keep streets clear for snow removal.

We have a great lineup ahead including live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow, and trivia nights starting this coming Tuesday and Wednesday at various local spots.
In a report from October 25, officers found a man passed out behind the wheel at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, leading to an arrest for O W I, his first offence.
Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight, and they are serving up the delicious Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, so make sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop before they close for the evening.
